paper.title_en: Metric reconstruction in a Bondi-like gauge
paper.abstract_en: Metric perturbations obtained from a Hertz potential in an ingoing radiation gauge (IRG) generically grow in an outgoing coordinate $r$ at future null infinity, and are therefore not asymptotically flat in the Bondi sense. Hollands and Toomani showed that this growth can be removed, within the Green--Hollands--Zimmerman (GHZ) framework, by an IRG-compatible ``residual'' gauge transformation together with a carefully chosen choice of the undetermined integration ``constants'' of the Hertz potential. In this work we turn that proof into a practical algorithm. We show that this entire completion is generated by a single ``Held Master Scalar'' (HMS), which can be thought of as a function on future null infinity. The HMS is obtained from the leading asymptotic piece of the $0$-Weyl scalar through a Teukolsky--Starobinsky inversion. We give explicit formulas for the four integration constants of the Hertz potential associated with the $0$-Weyl scalar, and for the residual gauge vector in terms of the HMS, thereby bringing the metric perturbation into a Bondi-like gauge. In Schwarzschild the entire construction is diagonal in $(\ell, m)$-modes and every completion field is available in closed form; in Kerr the construction is tri-diagonal. We have numerically implemented the full scheme in $(\ell,m)$ and in $m$-modes, including the corrector piece of the GHZ framework. We illustrate our scheme numerically for a point-particle on a circular orbit in a puncture scheme in Schwarzschild and in Kerr, by demonstrating the Bondi-like fall-off. We also find agreement with the known Detweiler redshift computations in Schwarzschild and Kerr. Our method directly gives the Bondi news, mass-, and angular momentum aspects, for which we give exemplary results in Kerr.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将GHZ框架中消除IRG规范下度规扰动增长的理论证明转化为可计算算法，显式给出Hertz势的四个积分常数与残余规范向量构造，并在Schwarzschild与Kerr下实现数值方案、验证Bondi型衰减及Detweiler红移一致性，进而直接给出Bondi news、质量与角动量方面。理论深度与构造性贡献突出，对广义相对论基础、渐近平直时空与引力波波形提取有明确参考价值。
decision.abstract_zh: 在入射辐射规范（IRG）下由Hertz势得到的度规扰动，一般在出射坐标 $r$ 上于未来零无穷处增长，因此按Bondi意义并非渐近平直。Hollands与Toomani证明，在Green--Hollands--Zimmerman（GHZ）框架内，可以通过与IRG兼容的“残余”规范变换，连同对Hertz势未定积分“常数”的精心选取，来消除这种增长。在本工作中，我们把这个证明转化为一个实用算法。我们表明，整个补全由一个单一的“Held主标量”（HMS）生成，它可以被视为未来零无穷上的一个函数。HMS由 $0$-Weyl标量的领头渐近部分经Teukolsky--Starobinsky反演得到。我们给出与 $0$-Weyl标量相关的Hertz势四个积分常数的显式公式，以及用HMS表示的残余规范矢量，从而把度规扰动带入Bondi型规范。在Schwarzschild情形下，整个构造在 $(\ell, m)$ 模下是对角的，且每个补全场都可以闭式给出；在Kerr情形下，该构造是三对角的。我们已在 $(\ell,m)$ 模和 $m$ 模下数值实现了完整方案，包括GHZ框架中的修正项。我们在Schwarzschild和Kerr中，针对穿刺方案下圆轨道上的点粒子，通过展示Bondi型衰减来数值演示我们的方案。我们还发现与Schwarzschild和Kerr中已知的Detweiler红移计算相一致。我们的方法直接给出Bondi news、质量方面和角动量方面，并给出了Kerr中的示例性结果。
